label: The crews
text: The two crews with the most league points. Each takes its break first (section 14.1). Fighters who are Laid up miss the Final like any other battle: only fighters who can play take part in it.

label: The world
text: The two players agree on one of the eight worlds. If they cannot agree, the player whose crew has more league points chooses. Use the world's page (chapter 12) for its always-on rule, pod rule and event table, and the first battle page's non-player models. Deploy on **battle lines** (section 11.1), whatever the table says. Ignore that page's terrain needs, set-up, battle rules, winning condition and prize, and replace anything it would put in the centre of the table with the stage.

label: The stage
text: A round template 6 inches across marks the stage at the centre of the table.

label: Words
text: Each player may give up to **three** Words, each from a different fighter. Big mouth and Showboats add none: the Final starts even. Everything else about Words is as usual (section 13.5). Words fulfilled in the Final pay XP, not league points.

label: The spotlight
text: From round 2, at the start of each round, each player names one of their fighters who is not down. That fighter is **Announced** until the end of the round, and if they put down an enemy in that time they are **Hyped** at once. No fighter can be in the spotlight two rounds running.

label: No way out
text: There is no evac in the Final (section 11.6). A side that breaks (section 11.4) loses the prize to the other.

label: The winning condition: the stage
text: At the end of the battle, the crew with more standing fighters in contact with or inside the stage wins. A tie goes to the crew that holds the field (section 11.5). If still tied, the crews are joint champions and each takes 15 parts and one roll on the finds table.

label: The prize
text: The crew that meets the winning condition is **champion of the season**: **20 parts and two rolls on the finds table** (section 14.7), and the title "Champions" written on its roll. It is not a tag and takes no tag slot. The other crew takes its share of the gate: **10 parts**.

label: The end
text: The battle ends as usual (section 11.3). Injuries are rolled as usual (section 13.2). The Final scores no league points.
